register.reg_condition: when FEAT_FGT2 is implemented and FEAT_AA64 is implemented

purpose_text.para: Provides controls for traps of MRRS, MRS and MRC reads of System registers.

configuration_text.para: If EL2 is not implemented, this register is RES0 from EL3.

field_description.para: Reserved, RES0.
Trap MRS reads of ACTLR_EL1 at EL1 using AArch64 to EL2.
This field is ignored by the PE and treated as zero when all of the following are true:

field_value_description.para: MRS reads of ACTLR_EL1 are not trapped by this mechanism.

If EL2 is implemented and enabled in the current Security state, then MRS reads of ACTLR_EL1 at EL1 using AArch64 are trapped to EL2 and reported with EC syndrome value 0x18, unless the read generates a higher priority exception.

field_reset_condition.condition: the highest implemented Exception level is EL2
